page_title: Configure time, time zone, and automatic time calibration
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- Display, remote control, GPS antenna

### Operation steps

1. Press the [ENTER] button on the remote control to enter the login interface, enter the password "999999", and automatically log in to the main menu
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=33badfcb667734475df3d0a85b008d6e)

2. Select [Settings] on the main menu interface, press " ENTER" key to enter the settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0d2be9ee3f8c50adafc8e14d9f054108)

3. Select [Basic Settings] in the [Settings] interface and press the "ENTER" key to enter the basic settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0142a61baba6091dd5a0984a682d437d)

4. Select [Time] in the [Basic Settings] interface, enter the time settings page, modify the time and time zone, and press "OK" to save after the modification
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=da3fb5e9688a663a8b31827f169954c4)

###Automatic time calibration
1. If the automatic time calibration is checked, the device will automatically calibrate the time after the GPS positioning is successful after the device is turned on
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=21a097352697ee7d186a9aba13dc2678)
